```{r}
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

str(kenya_df)
summary(kenya_df)
```

STEP 2: Rename columns clearly and keep the full dataset
```{r}
kenya_df <- kenya_df %>%
  rename(
    ClaimAmount = Total_Claim_Amount_KES,
    VehicleCategory = Vehicle_Type,
    AccidentArea = Region,
    Age = Customer_Age,
    VehiclePrice = Vehicle_Value_KES
  )

names(kenya_df)
```

STEP 3: Basic cleaning and feature checks
```{r}
# Create ClaimID if not present
if (!"ClaimID" %in% names(kenya_df)) {
  kenya_df$ClaimID <- 1:nrow(kenya_df)
}

# Convert key text columns to character consistently
char_cols <- c("Gender", "AccidentArea", "VehicleCategory", "Use_Purpose",
               "Accident_Cause", "Third_Party_Only", "Policy_ID")

for (col in char_cols) {
  if (col %in% names(kenya_df)) {
    kenya_df[[col]] <- as.character(kenya_df[[col]])
  }
}

# Check missing values
colSums(is.na(kenya_df))
```

 STEP 4: Create proxy fraud label using robust rule-based logic
```{r}
# 1. Compute 75th percentile of claim amount within each vehicle type
claim_thresholds <- kenya_df %>%
  group_by(VehicleCategory) %>%
  summarise(
    q75_claim = quantile(ClaimAmount, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Join thresholds back
kenya_df <- kenya_df %>%
  left_join(claim_thresholds, by = "VehicleCategory")

# 3. Create suspicious conditions
kenya_df <- kenya_df %>%
  mutate(
    rule_high_freq_high_claim = ifelse(
      Claims_Frequency > 2 & ClaimAmount >= q75_claim, 1, 0
    ),

    rule_old_vehicle_theft = ifelse(
      Accident_Cause == "Theft" & Vehicle_Age > 15, 1, 0
    ),

    rule_many_prev_claims_high_amount = ifelse(
      Previous_Claims_Count >= 2 & ClaimAmount > median(ClaimAmount, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0
    ),

    rule_low_premium_high_claim = ifelse(
      Annual_Premium_KES < quantile(Annual_Premium_KES, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE) &
      ClaimAmount > quantile(ClaimAmount, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 1, 0
    )
  )

# 4. Combine rules into a proxy fraud score
kenya_df <- kenya_df %>%
  mutate(
    FraudProxyScore = rule_high_freq_high_claim +
                      rule_old_vehicle_theft +
                      rule_many_prev_claims_high_amount +
                      rule_low_premium_high_claim
  )

# 5. Final proxy label
kenya_df <- kenya_df %>%
  mutate(
    FraudProxy = ifelse(FraudProxyScore >= 1, 1, 0)
  )
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)
```

STEP 8: Build a simple Kenyan benchmark model now
8A. Prepare structured features
```{r}
library(dplyr)

kenya_model_df <- kenya_df %>%
  select(
    FraudProxy,
    Age,
    Gender,
    AccidentArea,
    VehicleCategory,
    Vehicle_Age,
    VehiclePrice,
    Vehicle_Engine_Capacity,
    Use_Purpose,
    Annual_Premium_KES,
    Claims_Frequency,
    ClaimAmount,
    No_Claim_Bonus_.,
    Accident_Cause,
    Policy_Term_Months,
    Previous_Claims_Count,
    Driver_Experience_Years,
    Third_Party_Only
  )

# Convert character columns to factor
for (col in names(kenya_model_df)) {
  if (is.character(kenya_model_df[[col]])) {
    kenya_model_df[[col]] <- as.factor(kenya_model_df[[col]])
  }
}

# Remove rows with missing values just in case
kenya_model_df <- na.omit(kenya_model_df)

# Dummy matrix
X_kenya <- model.matrix(FraudProxy ~ . - 1, data = kenya_model_df)

# Target
y_kenya <- kenya_model_df$FraudProxy

cat("Rows in Kenya model data:", nrow(kenya_model_df), "\n")
cat("Rows in X_kenya:", nrow(X_kenya), "\n")
cat("Length of y_kenya:", length(y_kenya), "\n")
table(y_kenya)
```

8B. Split for benchmark model
```{r}
set.seed(42)

idx <- createDataPartition(y_kenya, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)

X_train_kenya <- X_kenya[idx, , drop = FALSE]
X_test_kenya  <- X_kenya[-idx, , drop = FALSE]
y_train_kenya <- y_kenya[idx]
y_test_kenya  <- y_kenya[-idx]

cat("Kenya benchmark train rows:", nrow(X_train_kenya), "\n")
cat("Kenya benchmark test rows:", nrow(X_test_kenya), "\n")
table(y_train_kenya)
table(y_test_kenya)
```

8C. Train a benchmark XGBoost on Kenyan proxy labels
```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(pROC)
library(PRROC)

dtrain_kenya <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_train_kenya, label = y_train_kenya)
dtest_kenya  <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_test_kenya, label = y_test_kenya)

params_kenya <- list(
  objective = "binary:logistic",
  eval_metric = "aucpr",
  max_depth = 4,
  eta = 0.05,
  subsample = 0.8,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8
)

xgb_kenya <- xgb.train(
  params = params_kenya,
  data = dtrain_kenya,
  nrounds = 150,
  verbose = 0
)

kenya_test_probs <- predict(xgb_kenya, dtest_kenya)
kenya_test_pred  <- ifelse(kenya_test_probs >= 0.5, 1, 0)
```

8D. Evaluate benchmark model
```{r}
calc_metrics <- function(y_true, probs, threshold = 0.5) {
  pred <- ifelse(probs >= threshold, 1, 0)

  cm <- table(
    factor(pred, levels = c(0,1)),
    factor(y_true, levels = c(0,1))
  )

  TN <- cm[1,1]
  FN <- cm[1,2]
  FP <- cm[2,1]
  TP <- cm[2,2]

  precision <- ifelse((TP + FP) == 0, 0, TP / (TP + FP))
  recall    <- ifelse((TP + FN) == 0, 0, TP / (TP + FN))
  f1        <- ifelse((precision + recall) == 0, 0,
                      2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall))
  accuracy  <- (TP + TN) / sum(cm)

  pos <- probs[y_true == 1]
  neg <- probs[y_true == 0]
  pr_auc <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos, scores.class1 = neg, curve = FALSE)$auc.integral
  roc_auc <- as.numeric(pROC::auc(y_true, probs))

  data.frame(
    Accuracy = accuracy,
    Precision = precision,
    Recall = recall,
    F1 = f1,
    AUC_ROC = roc_auc,
    AUC_PR = pr_auc
  )
}

calc_metrics(y_test_kenya, kenya_test_probs)
```

STEP 9: Prepare for full ensemble validation
```{r}
kenya_meta <- data.frame(
  PXGB = xgb_predictions,
  PLSTM = lstm_predictions,
  PGNN = gnn_predictions
)

kenya_meta$FinalProb <- predict(meta_glm, newdata = kenya_meta, type = "response")
kenya_meta$FinalPred <- ifelse(kenya_meta$FinalProb >= best_threshold, 1, 0)

kenya_df$FinalProb <- kenya_meta$FinalProb
kenya_df$FinalPred <- kenya_meta$FinalPred
```

STEP 11: Compare benchmark XGBoost vs full ensemble
```{r}
# Full benchmark predictions on all Kenyan rows used in kenya_model_df
dfull_kenya <- xgb.DMatrix(data = X_kenya, label = y_kenya)

kenya_benchmark_full_probs <- predict(xgb_kenya, dfull_kenya)
kenya_benchmark_full_pred  <- ifelse(kenya_benchmark_full_probs >= 0.5, 1, 0)

benchmark_full_results <- calc_metrics(
  y_true = y_kenya,
  probs = kenya_benchmark_full_probs,
  threshold = 0.5
)

benchmark_full_results
```
comparison table
```{r}
model_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  benchmark_full_results %>% mutate(Model = "Kenyan XGBoost Benchmark", .before = 1),
  kenya_ensemble_results %>% mutate(Model = "Full Ensemble", .before = 1)
)

model_comparison
```

```{r}
# Add benchmark predictions

kenya_eval_df$BenchmarkPred <- kenya_benchmark_full_pred

kenya_eval_df$FinalProb <- kenya_df$FinalProb[1:nrow(kenya_eval_df)]
kenya_eval_df$FinalPred <- kenya_df$FinalPred[1:nrow(kenya_eval_df)]
```
